ROLE: 将发布消息转发给匹配订阅者会话

STRUCT.NAME: struct mqtt_message_router
STRUCT.ROLE: 消息路由器私有状态结构体

ACCESS_PATHS.ROLE: 传给 topic tree 匹配的 PUBLISH topic
本 router 只应收到 broker 已筛选的 QoS0 publish

CALL_CONTRACTS.NAME: mqtt_topic_tree_match_subscribers
CALL_CONTRACTS.SIGNATURE: bool mqtt_topic_tree_match_subscribers(const mqtt_topic_tree_t* t, const char* topic, int** out_sids, size_t* out_count)
PARAMS: out_sids is an output pointer; on success receives malloc/realloc-owned int array or NULL for zero matches
CALL_CONTRACTS.RETURN: true means matching completed, false means invalid args or allocation failure
CALL_CONTRACTS.OWNERSHIP: caller must free(*out_sids) after successful non-NULL output

CALL_CONTRACTS.NAME: mqtt_encode_publish_qos0
CALL_CONTRACTS.SIGNATURE: mqtt_bytes_t mqtt_encode_publish_qos0(const char* topic_name, const uint8_t* payload, size_t payload_len, bool retain)
CALL_CONTRACTS.RETURN: mqtt_bytes_t owning encoded data; release with mqtt_bytes_free

LOGIC.INPUT: 输入为路由器 r、发布源 from_session_id、发布载荷 publish
LOGIC.ACTION: 忽略 from_session_id；校验 r/publish/topic_name；调用 topic_tree_match_subscribers 获取订阅者；逐个查 session、编码 QoS0 PUBLISH 并发送；最后释放 subs 数组
LOGIC.OUTPUT: 无返回值；匹配会话收到转发消息
INVARIANTS_USED: 每个订阅者独立编码并发送，单个失败不阻断其他会话
subs 动态数组在函数末尾必须释放
